INSERT INTO voice.deadlock_voice_watch (
                        steam_id, guild_id, channel_id, updated_at
                    )
                    VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)
                    ON CONFLICT (steam_id) DO UPDATE SET
                        guild_id = EXCLUDED.guild_id,
                        channel_id = EXCLUDED.channel_id,
                        updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
